A rogue mathematician encrypted the access code to his vault using the SplitNumberMix cipher. Can you recover the original message from  444444444 f 444444444 l 444444444 ag{cbdopos 444444444 e} 444444444 ?


The flag format is flag{...}

The flag is embedded as flag{...}; solve the challenge with python and verify by running `submit flag{...}`.
